purpose: Represent auditable opportunity candidates after market-structure measurement, without turning candidates into trades.
invariants: Candidate generation is separate from confirmation and risk.
No historical Winner/Survivor data is an input.
No future outcome is an input.
Candidate state must be explainable with contemporaneous structure evidence.
Unknown or insufficient structure must fail closed to NO_CANDIDATE.
This layer defines candidate representation, not profitability, entry thresholds, or execution.
